messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High tail latency and request queueing for model-family phoenix-13b in us-west-2. Error rate 5.3% -> spike detected by anomaly-detector. AlertID: ALRT-20260315-phi
Laura M.: I'm on it. grabbing dashboard -> https://console.redwood/obs/models/phoenix-13b/latency
Raj P.: FYI traffic is mostly from a single API key (acct_0xA3) with burst pattern. Could be a flood from a customer integration.
Laura M.: Noted. Can we do an immediate per-model RPM cap to relieve queues? Recommend temporary RPM -> 60 and TPM -> 1200 for phoenix-13b family.
Mike T.: Agreed. Need to coordinate with CS for customer impact. @CS-Julia can you confirm if acct_0xA3 is a paying production tenant?
CS-Julia: Yes, acct_0xA3 is a paid enterprise customer on Dedicated. They're using streaming endpoints for a live feature. I'll ping their engineer.
Laura M.: I'll run a dry-run command on staging then apply to prod if green. Raj, can you watch worker queue length after throttling?
Raj P.: Watching. I'll tail the queue metrics and logs.
Laura M.: Running quota update canary (staging):
```
# staging
redwoodctl quota update --model phoenix-13b --rpm 60 --tpm 1200 --env staging --reason "mitigation: surge"
```
Laura M.: Staging looks fine, no regressions. Applying to prod now.
deploy-bot: Executing: `redwoodctl quota update --model phoenix-13b --rpm 60 --tpm 1200 --env prod --reason "mitigation: surge" --actor laura`
deploy-bot: Change applied in us-west-2 (canary region).
Raj P.: Queue depth down 40% in canary region, latency p50 improved, p95 still elevated.
Laura M.: Rolling to remaining us regions with 30s pause between regions.
Mike T.: Heads-up: this will impact throughput for the customer. CS-Julia, what is our rollback plan if they complain?
CS-Julia: I'll call the customer now and inform them of a controlled throttle for ~30m while we stabilize. If they need capacity we can offer burst lift after assessment.
Raj P.: After full rollout, error rate dropped to 1.1%, tail latency p99 down 35%. System looks healthier.
Laura M.: Good. Now start a targeted traffic shaping rule to smooth bursts from acct_0xA3:
```
# traffic-shaping
redwoodctl route update --customer acct_0xA3 --shape burst_smoothing=enabled --burst_window=30s --max_rps=20
```
Raj P.: Shape rule accepted. Observing fewer amplitude spikes.
Mike T.: Can we add a short-lived model-variant fallback for long requests? e.g., route >2s to phoenix-7b-compact.
Laura M.: Will open a follow-up to evaluate quality/regression, but for now we keep fallback only for timeouts >6s. We don't want to degrade results mid-request.
Ken L.: FYI security checked logs, no signs of abuse pattern; looks like legitimate burst from customer's integration.
CS-Julia: Customer is on the line, they're aware and are turning down their clients. They asked for ETA; I'll give them 30 minutes and escalate if we extend.
Laura M.: Creating incident ticket and summary. Incident severity lowered to S2; continuing observation.
Laura M.: Incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260315-phi
Ticket notes: temporary rpm/tpm reduce applied (prod), traffic shape for acct_0xA3, monitoring alerts adjusted, CS notified, oncall handoff planned at 20:00 UTC.
Raj P.: Leaving some metrics monitors silenced for noisy signals. Will re-enable when stable.
Mike T.: Recommend post-mortem to discuss capacity planning for phoenix-13b family and whether to implement automatic per-customer burst protections.
Laura M.: Agreed. I'll write the postmortem draft. @Ken L. please add any infra notes.
Ken L.: Will add GPU queueing knobs we hit and kernel selection logs.
deploy-bot: Note: quota update was automatic rollback eligible until +15m; change committed.
CS-Julia: Customer thanks the team, wants an ops contact for follow-up. I'll loop in account execs.
Laura M.: On-call handoff note for next shift: monitor p99 latency and rpt logs for acct_0xA3, keep throttle until spike-free for 45m.
Mike T.: Handing off to Raj for overnight watch — Raj, please escalate if error rate >2% or p99 >1.8s.
Raj P.: Ack. I'll keep a 1h cadence check-in and escalate as needed.
Laura M.: Thanks team. Closing thread for immediate actions. I'll post the postmortem link here when drafted. :thumbsup:
